articles.title: Lebanon’s death toll nears 3,000 since March
articles.summary: Israel executed air strikes in southern Lebanon, confirmed by Lebanese security sources. Concurrently, Hizbullah declared new attacks on Israeli forces, indicating an escalation of ongoing hostilities. This renewed cross-border military engagement underscores the volatile security situation between the two entities, demanding close attention for geopolitical understanding and potential regional implications.

articles.title: Show HN: Uber burned its 2026 AI budget by April. Why? 73% redundant reads
articles.summary: This article details a field study on AI coding agents, analyzing the computational 'tokens' they expend during operation. It introduces a practical framework aimed at optimizing and significantly reducing this token usage. This research is vital for enhancing the efficiency and cost-effectiveness of AI development, crucial for future technological advancements and resource management in various sectors.

articles.title: Markiplier’s ‘Iron Lung’ To Debut On YouTube After $50M Theatrical Run
articles.summary: Filmmaker and content creator Markiplier's horror feature film, 'Iron Lung', is scheduled to debut on YouTube on May 31st. This release follows a successful initial phase, highlighting Markiplier's venture into feature filmmaking. The premiere on a global video platform showcases evolving content distribution by prominent digital creators to a worldwide audience.

articles.title: Zelensky's long-range strikes on Russia are 'swinging the advantage back Ukraine's way' and momentum shift in war is 'finally filtering through' to Putin, expert reveals
articles.summary: Ukraine's recent extensive long-range drone strikes against Russia, involving almost 600 drones, are interpreted by an expert as a sign that the war is increasingly shifting in Kyiv's favour. These strategic attacks highlight Ukraine's evolving offensive capabilities and their impact on the ongoing conflict, marking a significant development in the military landscape and geopolitical struggle.
